summary: $42 outside fair week re-read and confirmed (undated page); hookups 50A/water/some sewer, 75+ sites, showers, dump, spring-through-fall confirmed. Stored RoverPass booking cleared: the listing is unclaimed, the fair's page gives only phone and email. Ownership reads private. Pets banned.
flags: OWNERSHIP: stored local; reads private. The fair's own pages: 'St. Joseph County Fair is a 501(c)(3) organization, and is one of the two privately owned fairgrounds in the state of Indiana'; footer on the camping page: 'The St. Joseph County 4-H Fairgrounds are a privately-operated facility.' Google lists it as '4-H Fair Inc'. County commissioners are not the operator.

IF PRIVATE, GATE FACTS: posted $42 (under $50; undated, page footer 2021, stored read 2026-10-15). Not shown as a Good Sam Park (no value). Presence: own website + phone 574-291-4870 confirmed. Google 'St. Joseph County Fairgrounds' 4.4 from 1,272 reviews, but those are the fair's: the five newest read were about the fair, monster trucks and a rock show, none about camping, so no camper quality signal. One 2-star: 'Dangerous driving spots! Good way to wreck something under your car or your tire with pointy metal sticking up!' (2 months ago, event parking, not camping). RV Life 3 stars, $$$. No long-stay character.

POLICY: the camping page's footer says 'We do not permit the following on the Fairgrounds: PETS (with the exception of service animals), WEAPONS of any kind, ALCOHOL, SKATEBOARDS...'. Read as written, a pet-free and alcohol-free campground; it does not carve out campers. Worth weighing as a questionable policy for a private park. A call would settle it.

ORDINARY NIGHT: page says camping is 'Spring through Fall' at $42 'outside of fair week', with '24 Hour Access', 'RV Rallies welcomed', 'Notre Dame Home Game Camping'; no booking channel, so an ordinary night is implied, not shown bookable. Old note's 'Apr-Nov when no events, book via RoverPass' not on any operator page (dropped).

PIN: 41.62122,-86.21571 is the gate on Ironwood Road. Imagery (leaf-off spring) shows buildings, barns, arena and mown fields; I can't see camp rows or pads, so no corrected pin offered; the whole grounds are within ~500 m. No water: not waterfront stands.
